experience.title: Professional Experience
experience.subtitle: Track record of delivering safety-critical ECU validation, HIL automation, and ADAS testing across world-class automotive programs.

uds_simulator.title: Founder & Developer
responsibilities: Built and launched a web-based UDS (ISO 14229) diagnostic simulator and learning platform using AI-assisted development and REST APIs.
Engineered production-level coverage across 19 diagnostic services, from diagnostic session control and security access to ECU firmware updates, with zero physical hardware required.
Designed an interactive visual learning engine featuring real-time protocol state machines and live request-response message flows.
Achieved WCAG 2.1 AAA accessibility compliance; pilot engineering teams recorded 60% faster onboarding and zero hardware damage during training.

test_lead.title: Test Lead
test_lead.jlr: Jaguar Land Rover (JLR), UK | Current assignment
jlr_responsibilities: Execute ECU functional and regression validation in Vector-based HIL environments using CANoe and CAPL, including manual test verification and failure analysis.
Automate Gherkin test scenarios through Python-based parsing and reusable step-definition (SD) files to generate CAPL test scripts for execution in CANoe.
Create and maintain missing SD files and CAPL functionality to support test coverage and resolve automation execution issues.
Perform UDS diagnostic testing and ECU software flashing using Corvos; use Lauterbach Trace32 for bootloader recovery and application software version restoration when needed.
Run overnight automated regression suites through Kiara and manage test cases, execution IDs and results in Jira Xray.
Version-control CAPL and step-definition assets in GitLab; use Jira and Confluence for test and engineering coordination.
Completed training in AI-DLC and prompt engineering; explored Amazon Kiro IDE with Jira, Confluence and GitLab integrations for AI-assisted Gherkin test automation.
responsibilities: Led system-level validation for steering wheel controls, horn, crash detection and related body-control features using dSPACE VEOS and ECU-TEST.
Managed requirements-to-test traceability with IBM RQM and DOORS Next Generation, achieving 95% requirement traceability.
Reduced manual test effort by 40% through ECU-TEST automation; developed reusable XAM signal mapping files that reduced setup time by 30%.
Supported integration, defect triage and resolution of 30+ issues across critical vehicle functions, working with software and validation teams.

senior_engineer.title: Specialist Embedded Test Engineer
senior_engineer.company: HL Klemove India Pvt Ltd (Halla Group)
responsibilities: Prepared and verified DCU-20 ECU test benches using CANcase XL interfaces, variable power supplies, JTAG/Trace32, JIG fixtures, CAN harnesses and DB9/120-ohm CAN termination; checked requirements, DBC, diagnostic and software inputs before testing.

Developed CANoe simulations for camera and radar inputs by integrating DBC files, configuring environment variables, implementing CAPL logic and linking control/monitoring panels for signal-level testing.
Established and maintained a Zero-DTC ADAS validation environment; checked ECU startup, sensor/network communication, diagnostic status, fault-triggering CAN signals and required recovery conditions.

Analyzed vehicle-variant requirements and designed ADAS failsafe test cases; automated execution in vTESTstudio/CANoe with configurable voltage, vehicle speed, variant coding and sensor blockage scenarios.
Verified camera/radar blockage fault detection, timing and recovery through UDS DTC status changes (0x89 active and 0x08 history), signal states and requirement-based acceptance criteria.
Executed smoke, End-of-Line (EOL), failsafe and Update Software Management (USM) testing; performed Trace32-assisted ECU flashing/debugging and published reviewed execution reports in Jira.
Served as project point of contact during an onsite assignment at Korea head office, coordinating test evidence, issues and engineering discussions with stakeholders.

test_engineer.title: Senior Embedded Test Engineer
test_engineer.company: Mando Softtech India Pvt Ltd (Halla Group)
responsibilities: Designed unit and integration tests for automotive radar/ADAS software, including adaptive cruise control systems, using VectorCAST.
Built automated regression workflows, reporting a 60% reduction in testing effort and 98% MC/DC structural coverage for radar programs.
Performed requirement reviews, defect analysis, work allocation and peer reviews; mentored junior engineers in coverage-driven unit testing.

junior_engineer.title: Test Engineer
responsibilities: Implemented VectorCAST unit tests for embedded automotive software; analyzed statement, branch and MC/DC coverage.
Maintained defect records and collaborated with developers to investigate and resolve software issues.
